identity.title: Move N-image verification preview decoding to the existing image factory

origin.summary: The user asked to resume the refactoring after the previous task appeared stuck in mobile status.

state.current_summary: PL-0031은 N-image verification preview decoding을 기존 OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory로 이동하는 구조 변경과 최종 검증을 완료했다. Controller의 직접 FileStream/BitmapImage/OnLoad coupling은 제거되었고 SelectedSourceImage/SelectedDrawingImage binding, selected-row state ownership, missing/corrupt null, frozen lifetime은 유지되었다. Debug/Release contract와 builds, RefactorAudit, Readiness, DocumentationIndex, issue-ledger, diff check가 통과했다. 전체 WPF/hardware/native 행렬은 미검증으로 기록했다.

objective.summary: Move N-image verification source/drawing preview path decoding from VisionToolNImageVerificationController to OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory without changing binding names, BitmapImage result type, missing-path null behavior, or verification workflow.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Reuse OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory; do not add a new interface, manager, wrapper, registry, or Partial.
Preserve SelectedSourceImage and SelectedDrawingImage binding names and BitmapImage types, OnLoad/frozen behavior, and null behavior for missing/corrupt files.
Keep evidence and generated test output on D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not create or reactivate a recurring schedule for this bounded slice.

criteria.text: The proof report records the current and intended owners, caller path, dependency direction, selected-row state writer, image lifetime owner, and preserved BitmapImage binding contract.

VisionToolNImageVerificationController no longer contains the direct File.Exists/FileStream/BitmapImage decode policy for selected evidence; the existing preview factory owns it and missing/corrupt paths still return null while valid results remain OnLoad and frozen.

A focused source/behavior contract, relevant Debug and Release builds, documentation index, issue-ledger validation, and targeted diff check pass; full WPF visual/hardware/native matrices remain explicitly unverified.

milestones.summary: Freeze the N-image preview owner, call path, and preserved binding/lifetime contract.
Move path-backed N-image preview decoding to the existing concrete image factory.
Run focused proof, builds, documentation, ledger, and diff checks.

evidence.observation: The proof report records the old and new owners, call path, SelectedRow state writer, BitmapImage binding contract, and removal of direct FileStream/BitmapImage OnLoad/Freeze decode policy from the N-image controller.

ToolNImageVerificationImageBoundaryContract passed 6/6: old coupling absence, factory ownership, BitmapImage binding preservation, valid dimensions/frozen lifetime, missing-path null, and corrupt-path null. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

Debug/Release focused contracts passed 6/6, Smoke Debug/Release builds and serial Solution Release build passed with 0 warnings/errors, RefactorAudit passed with 54 Partial declarations and 0 project cycles, Readiness Debug/Release passed, DocumentationIndex reported IndexedPaths=300/Routes=17/RootRedirects=102, and targeted diff plus PL-0031 ledger validation passed.

events.summary: N-image verification controller의 중복 path-backed BitmapImage decode는 새 service가 아니라 기존 OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory.TryCreateFromPath(path, 0)로 이동한다. SelectedSourceImage/SelectedDrawingImage binding 타입과 selection/result state ownership은 유지한다.

PL-0031의 M1 owner proof, M2 existing factory extraction, M3 final proof를 닫는다. Controller의 직접 file-backed WPF decode가 제거되었고, 기존 factory 재사용과 binding/state 보존이 focused Debug/Release 증거로 확인되었다. 미검증 UI/hardware/legal 행렬은 범위 밖 증거로 남긴다.
PL-0031의 세 completion criteria와 세 milestone이 모두 current evidence로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 동일 owner는 새 defect, requirement, failed criterion, 또는 dependency boundary가 생기기 전에는 다시 열지 않는다.
